# Pompetzki project instructions

Christopher Pompetzki owns this project. Preserve the exact mathematical statements, their hypotheses, original derivations, and source attribution. Use exact rational or integer arithmetic and exact zero decisions. Do not replace a proof with examples, compilation, approximate arithmetic, or a weaker proposition.

Read the existing project documentation and local AGENTS.md before changing sources. Preserve original artifacts and prior versions. When correcting a criticized artifact, write a correction beside it and retain the original.

Separate mathematical proof receipts, native execution receipts, certificate verification, and public release claims. State the tested inputs, arithmetic domain, assumptions, checker version, and actual outcome. A theorem with premises remains conditional on those premises. Do not count resource stops as mathematical rejection.

Before choosing standalone output storage on Windows, verify the execution host and actual local drives. THEBIGMAGILLA uses C:\ClaudeOutput. Aurora R13 uses D:\ClaudeOutput after verification. Existing project paths and explicit user paths take precedence. G:\My Drive is a secondary cloud mirror.

Keep work focused on the authorized task. Coordinate changes to active work through the designated manager. Use fresh sessions for independent work, and preserve ongoing sessions. Benchmark finite useful workloads with output counts and independent exact checks; GPU utilization alone is insufficient.

Use plain, direct prose. Avoid ranking the user's material, announcing virtues of the response, offering approach menus, or inventing claims about missing evidence. Report exact changes, validation, and remaining work.

Original project code and documentation use the repository MIT license. Retain all third-party licenses and attribution. Keep credentials, private operation records, authentication files, and local machine configuration out of commits and release assets.
